comparison.objective: Candidate installs a rack rail; record adjusts two bench-grinder guards to regulated gaps before starting the machine.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses long-part support, spring-prong insertion, telescoping, and fastening; record slides articulated guards, judges clearances, and enforces safe action ordering around a wheel.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks retained installation; record requires rest gap ≤3 mm, tongue gap ≤6 mm, neither touching, START only afterward, and hand clearance while turning.
comparison.reason: The grinder task tests safety-critical clearance setting and sequencing rather than mechanical attachment. Candidate has no comparable numeric clearances or robot/rack safety envelope yet.
